rationale: Access Engineer in V/Line's Projects Access Interface team, Melbourne: assessing third party access applications, reviewing proposed works for safety and operational requirements, issuing Site Access Permits and keeping accurate records, which overlaps Marc's 2019 to 2020 Philippines site work (drawing reviews, inspections, safety checks, site and material records).

Advert says rail experience is welcomed but not essential and asks for experience in an engineering, construction or project environment in civil or structures disciplines, process and compliance work, Microsoft Office and stakeholder communication; Marc has civil site work, a BSCE (2019), an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Feb 2026) and Microsoft Office.
Melbourne hybrid role with occasional network travel suits a Melton base; no citizenship, PR or minimum years gate in the advert, and it invites applicants who do not exactly match.
caution: Not a graduate role: V/Line will compare Marc against people with Australian rail or project experience. His site experience is under one year and was in the Philippines. The role is fixed term to June 2029 while Marc's work rights run to December 2027, which Marc should be ready to discuss honestly if asked. Selection includes a medical category 3 check, online assessments and video screening.
gaps: No rail, track or rail access experience
No Australian site or office work experience yet; site work was in the Philippines 2019 to 2020
Site Access Permit and third party access processes would be new
